result_text:
`plan` now always puts the dogs nothing depends on in the final stage, cycle or not. `cargo check -p shep-core` passes. I did not run any tests.

In `crates/shep-core/src/config/graph.rs`, the push of that stage now comes after the stages for nodes that depend on the cycle. Nothing else in the plan changes. The doc comment on `plan` now lists the stage order as boot-first dogs, the ordinary sort, the cyclic stage, the nodes depending on the cycle, then the remaining dogs.

Next: run `cargo test -p shep-daemon --lib --all-features -- --skip ::slow::`. `crates/shep-daemon`'s boot code consumes this plan.
